name: Ran
subtitle: The Sea's Net
lore: Violent and rapacious, Ran is the sea that takes. She is mother of its grasping waves, ruler of the depths where the bones of drowned sailors come to rest. Since the Shattering she has worked to expand the boundaries of her aquatic dominion, flooding coastlines, dragging ships below, and otherwise taking the worshipers of other Asgardian gods of both the living and the dead.
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when placing a [Debuff] or [Disable] on an enemy

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Drowning Vigour
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy with a 35% chance to place [mechanic:lock-ultimate] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Frozen Waves
skills.description: Attack all enemies with a 50% chance to place [mechanic:freeze] on each target for 1 turn. If an enemy is below 50% HP, [mechanic:freeze] cannot be resisted. If [mechanic:freeze] is not placed, place [mechanic:init-down-ii] on the target for 2 turns instead.

skills.name: Cold Depths
skills.description: Attacks decrease 10% of the target’s Turn Meter. If the target is below 50% HP, steal 10% Turn Meter instead and increase the Turn Meter of all allies by the same amount. Allies can only gain turn meter once per attack.
